summary: Phase D part 2 — Project Brief E2E fully verified. Backend: 238/238 pytests PASS (incl. 4 new test_project_brief_e2e.py). Frontend: admin /admin/onboarding renders 15 'AI Brief' wand buttons; clicking opens ProjectBriefDialog with 3 phase tabs + pre-filled prompt + summary textarea + send-for-approval button. Client /portal shows 'Project Brief' tab with amber pulse dot when pending; tab renders ProjectBriefView with 3 color-coded phase cards (phase1/phase2/phase3) + Approve button. Approve → tab disappears + brief appears in ApprovedBriefsAccordion under the Orders tab (with project_name + approved_at + approved_by_email).
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectBriefView.jsx approve handler uses native window.confirm() blocking dialog. Works fine in production but couples flow to browser modal — consider replacing with shadcn AlertDialog for consistent UX + easier testability (Playwright auto-dismisses native confirms unless a dialog handler is registered).

ProjectBriefDialog renders only the active tab's prompt/summary in DOM (so brief-prompt-phase2 / brief-prompt-phase3 testids only exist when those tabs are active). This is fine but worth noting for future automated tests — must click each tab before asserting the testid.

Approve POST /api/clients/me/briefs/{id}/approve does email + slack fire-and-forget — confirmed idempotent on second call (returns 200 with status='approved' unchanged). Founder email + activity_log + slack are properly try/except-wrapped so they never fail the API.
project_brief_routes.py prompt builder handles missing phases gracefully ('didn't share any feature references' fallback) — verified by test_prompt_generator_handles_missing_phases.
Auto-resolve of company_id by primary_email + auto-derive project_name from phase3.project_name (or onboarding email-prefix fallback) verified.

rca_of_the_issue: Initial UI test reported 'approve click did not fire' — RCA: approve handler in /app/frontend/src/pages/client/ProjectBriefView.jsx:36 uses window.confirm() which Playwright auto-dismisses (returns false) unless a dialog handler is explicitly registered. Re-ran with page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) and the full approve→tab-disappear→accordion-renders flow worked end-to-end. NOT a production bug — real users see and click 'OK' on the confirm. Recommended (non-blocking) enhancement: replace native confirm with shadcn AlertDialog for consistent UX.
